notes: Source: official Haivision "Air Series" datasheet (HVS-DS-AIR-241201), fetched from https://www3.haivision.com/datasheet-haivision-air.pdf (redirects to storage.pardot.com host, both Haivision-controlled). "Haivision Air" is a product family with four variants — Air200, Air220, Air220-5G, Air320e-5G — that differ only in encoder support (H.265/HEVC on Air320e-5G only; all support H.264/AVC) and embedded cellular modem generation (5G/4G/3G on the -5G models vs. 4G/3G on Air220/Air200); the physical interface list in the datasheet is shared across all four models, so it is reported once here as "Air Series." Device is a handheld/portable bonded-cellular video encoder/transmitter, not rack-mountable (rackUnits omitted). Also present but omitted from ports (no matching connector id in the schema — not AV signal/power connectors): 1x SD card slot (local recording) and 4x micro SIM slots (for the internal cellular modems). USB 3.0 Type-A ports graded usb-5g (standard USB 3.0/SuperSpeed rate); they can also host external cellular/Wi-Fi/Ethernet dongles as "extension links." Ethernet is confirmed Gigabit in the Network Connections section. Power section states "DC input 19V" with an internal 48Wh battery (up to 3 hours) — connector style for the DC input is not specified, so dc-barrel was chosen as the closest generic match (flagged in the port note).
